The '''Hedrett Medical Center''' was a building that was located in [[Hedrett]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. [[Osten Dal'Nay]] was born there during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
